bio.title: Who I am
bio.p1: Versatile, passionate and deeply committed, I draw on multidisciplinary expertise spanning insurance, web and mobile development, cybersecurity and web design.
bio.p2: My path started with a degree in mathematics, before training as a web integrator developer and then as an insurance technician. This dual background gives me a rare perspective: I understand both a company's business logic and how to translate it into reliable technical systems.
bio.p3: On this portfolio, I apply my own method: a Symfony back office for management, an API Platform layer as the single entry point, a decoupled Next.js frontend, and an AI assistant that represents me and qualifies requests even before we talk directly.

vision.title: My view of the craft, today and tomorrow
vision.lede: What I think about the current state of web development, and what's changing.
vision.todayText: API-first decoupling is becoming the norm rather than the exception: a backend handling data and business logic, an API as the single entry point, and interchangeable frontends depending on the use case (web, mobile, assistant).
vision.tomorrowText: AI assistants will become a fully-fledged interaction layer, on par with a web or mobile frontend, consuming the same API — not a bolted-on gadget, but an interface designed from the start.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data is collected on this site, why, for how long, and how you can exercise your rights — in line with GDPR principles.
privacy.controllerText: Horlynat Mampassi Mbama, independent full-stack developer based in Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, is the controller responsible for the data collected on this site.
privacy.dataContact: Contact and quote forms: name, email, phone (depending on the channel chosen), description of your project or request.
privacy.dataAccount: Account creation (client or freelancer): name, email, password — never stored in plain text, hashed by the server.
privacy.dataProject: Quote request: service category, indicative budget, desired timeline, and any detail provided via the qualification assistant.
privacy.dataFreelance: Freelancer sign-up: specialties, availability, portfolio and free-form bio, provided at your own initiative.
privacy.dataTechnical: Technical data: your IP address is used transiently (not stored) to limit abusive form submissions.
privacy.dataAiAssistant: Conversational AI assistant: the text of the questions you ask it is sent to third-party AI providers to generate a reply (see "Data recipients"). No trace of that text is kept in our own database — only anonymized metadata is (length, cost, timestamp, a non-reversible hash of your IP address).
privacy.purposeText: This information is used only to qualify your request, get back to you, manage your account where applicable, prepare a quote or arrange an appointment. It is never resold or used for advertising purposes.
privacy.legalBasisText: Processing is based on your explicit consent (form checkboxes), on the performance of a contract when you create an account, and on legitimate interest for abuse prevention (rate-limiting form submissions).
privacy.retentionText: Account data (client or freelancer) is kept for as long as the account remains active. Quote or appointment requests that don't lead to a project are kept only for as long as needed to process them, then deleted. Anonymized metadata from AI assistant exchanges is automatically deleted after 90 days.
privacy.recipientsText: Your data is accessible only to Horlynat Mampassi Mbama, as data controller. No data is sold, rented, or shared with third parties for commercial or advertising purposes; this site does not use any third-party analytics or tracking tool. Technical exception: questions asked to the AI assistant are sent to Google (Gemini, for relevant-content retrieval) and Anthropic (Claude, for generating the reply), two providers located outside the European Union acting as technical subprocessors for this one feature, under their respective API terms of service — never for advertising purposes on our part.
privacy.rightsText: In line with GDPR principles, you have a right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction and objection regarding your personal data, as well as a right to portability for the data you provided.
privacy.rightsContact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us via the <link>contact form</link>.
privacy.securityText: Exchanges with the site are encrypted (HTTPS/TLS). Passwords are hashed by the server and are never stored or transmitted in plain text. The login session is kept in a protected (httpOnly) cookie, inaccessible to browser scripts.
privacy.cookiesText: This site uses a deliberately small number of cookies, all strictly necessary for it to function. Details are available in our <link>cookie policy</link>.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This page lists, exhaustively and honestly, everything this site stores in your browser: there is nothing hidden.
cookies.essentialText: This site uses two cookies, both essential to its basic functioning. No consent is required for these cookies under GDPR and the ePrivacy directive, since they are strictly necessary for the requested service.
cookies.sessionCookiePurpose: Session cookie: keeps you signed in while you're identified in your client or freelancer space.
cookies.sessionCookieDuration: Httponly and secure, expires with your login session.
cookies.localeCookiePurpose: Remembers your chosen language (French or English) so you don't have to reselect it on every visit.
cookies.localeCookieDuration: About 1 year, or until you change language.
cookies.localStorageText: The display theme (light or dark) you choose is remembered in your browser's local storage (localStorage), not in a cookie. It stays on your device until you change it or clear this site's data.
cookies.noTrackingText: This site does not use any analytics, audience measurement, advertising, or third-party social network tool. No browsing data is collected or shared for statistical or advertising purposes.
cookies.noBannerTitle: Why there is no consent banner
cookies.noBannerText: A consent banner is only legally required for non-essential cookies (audience measurement, advertising, etc.). Since this site uses none, no banner is shown to you — a deliberate choice of simplicity over a checkbox for form's sake.
cookies.controlText: You can delete this site's cookies and local storage at any time from your browser settings. Deleting the session cookie will simply sign you out of your space.
